result.summary: Found 3 issues: a major localization bug with an untranslated string, a minor truncated restaurant name, and a minor layout/contrast concern on category chips.

issues.description: Section header displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text (should be e.g. 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing translation entry in the localization files so the proper heading string is rendered.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off at the right edge of the 'Fastest near you' carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add proper ellipsis truncation or widen the card/name area so full names are readable.

issues.description: The horizontally scrollable category chips are cut off at the right edge with no visual affordance (partial chip barely visible), which may be missed by users.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial next chip visibility to hint at horizontal scrolling.
